ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PowerShell In Registry Run Keys
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential PowerShell commands or code within registry run keys Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\WOW6432Node\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\Run.*")) AND (Details = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR Details = RGX(".*pwsh\\ .*") OR Details = RGX(".*FromBase64String.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadFile\\(.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadString\\(.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ hidden\\ .*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ 1\\ .*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\-windowstyle\\ hidden.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\-window\\ hidden.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\ \\-nop\\ .*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\ \\-encodedcommand\\ .*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\-ExecutionPolicy\\ Bypass.*") OR Details = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Expression.*") OR Details = RGX(".*IEX\\ \\(.*") OR Details = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Command.*") OR Details = RGX(".*ICM\\ \\-.*") OR Details = RGX(".*Invoke\\-WebRequest.*") OR Details = RGX(".*IWR\\ .*") OR Details = RGX(".*Invoke\\-RestMethod.*") OR Details = RGX(".*IRM\\ .*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\ \\-noni\\ .*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\ \\-noninteractive\\ .*")))
